caption: The drawing features a decorative architectural motif with a variety of colorful geometric and organic shapes. In the lower left, there are two columns with bases composed of blue and green diamond patterns, topped by blue and white swirling borders, and flanked by panels containing peach, pale blue, and red elements with ornamental borders. The columns rise into tall, narrow decorative panels in shades of orange, green, red, and blue, with flowing, wavy, organic line patterns and stylized motifs. The floor is illustrated with reddish-orange rectangular tiles. Above the columns and in the central background, there is a black wall or step with a scalloped white and brown trim, and above it, a frieze displaying a repeated floral and scrollwork pattern in green, red, and blue. To the right, there is a large circle containing three decorative border samples: a green leaf motif, a blue and green diamond with curlicues centered on a blue stripe, and an orange-red three-loop motif with yellow. Above and beside the circle are two squares, each featuring a stylized arrow or swirl design in reddish-orange on a peach background. The overall color palette includes shades of orange, red, blue, green, peach, brown, white, and a touch of yellow. The composition is arranged with a combination of vertical, horizontal, and round shapes, with patterns repeated in different areas of the drawing.
title: Pilaster and Sidewall in Church San Luis Rey Mission
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
